blocks.html: Recreation space provided in Quality Housing buildings, in buildings converted pursuant to Article I, Chapter, or in any other building as part of requirements in effect prior to December 5, 2024, or recreation space that is provided pursuant to the requirements of Section 23-63 (Required Recreation Space in Multiple Dwelling Residences) after December 5, 2024, may be modified, relocated or otherwise reconfigured, provided that the requirements of Section 23-63 are met for all newly created spaces.
blocks.plainText: Recreation space provided in Quality Housing buildings, in buildings converted pursuant to Article I, Chapter, or in any other building as part of requirements in effect prior to December 5, 2024, or recreation space that is provided pursuant to the requirements of Section 23-63 (Required Recreation Space in Multiple Dwelling Residences) after December 5, 2024, may be modified, relocated or otherwise reconfigured, provided that the requirements of Section 23-63 are met for all newly created spaces.
